sourceCautions: Texas Children's 2018 referral PDF has an arithmetic typo in its terbinafine quarter-tablet row (67.5 mg vs 250/4 = 62.5 mg); that row was not copied. Its historical Medicaid coverage statement was not adopted.
BAD May 2023 patient leaflet has UK-specific licensing statements; these were not applied to US practice.
Current nystatin label contains in-vitro dermatophyte wording; labeled Candida indication and clinical tinea guidance govern the teaching distinction.
Reviewed CVS miconazole powder label has a marketing end date in 2025; used as a labeled dosing example, not evidence that this particular SKU is currently marketed.

The 2014 BAD guideline is cited only for historical alternative-treatment evidence, not as a newly issued guideline. April 2026 BAD advice and current US labels checked separately; UK-only licensing and availability statements were not adopted.

nailAlternatives.status: implemented with current labeling, April 2026 patient guidance and explicitly historical 2014 evidence
nailAlternatives.finding: April 2026 BAD leaflet supports fluconazole when terbinafine/itraconazole unsuitable. 2014 guideline provides historical posaconazole evidence and explains griseofulvin limitations. Preserve US-specific labeling; do not generalize historical newer-triazole safety claims.
